novel_features.name: Worst-airports ranking
novel_features.description: Rank the network's airports right now by cumulative delay and cancellations — the web map color-codes but never ranks.
novel_features.rationale: Requires sorting the full synced airport catalog by cumulativeDelay and canceledPercentage; the site only color-codes statuses on a map.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs 'which airports are worst right now', this answers in one command instead of scraping the map.

novel_features.name: Flight lookup by number
novel_features.description: Find one flight by number across arrivals and departures boards — status, original vs actual time, gate, belt, terminal.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining both flight boards and filtering by flight number; the web UI separates boards and needs eyeballing.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The 'when is my flight actually leaving' question answered in one deterministic command.

novel_features.name: Network airline disruption
novel_features.description: One airline's delay/cancel/divert footprint aggregated across every synced airport — impossible per-airport on the site.
novel_features.rationale: Requires scanning disruptedAirlines[] across all synced airport details and grouping by airline; the site is per-airport only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Travel agents and ops folks ask 'which airline is the worst offender across my hubs today' — this answers it network-wide.

novel_features.name: Airport comparison
novel_features.description: Side-by-side status, delays, warnings, and flight rules for two airports.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining two airport detail records; the web app shows one airport at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choosing between alternates (SFO vs OAK) is a two-entity question the site cannot express.

novel_features.name: Route disruption check
novel_features.description: Both directions of one origin-destination pair's delay/cancel/divert stats, joined from each side's disrupted routes.
novel_features.rationale: disruptedRoutes are directional (origin-only); the reciprocal view requires a second fetch and manual reconciliation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Route data exists only from one airport's perspective; this shows both ends of the same route.

novel_features.name: Healthy-alternates finder
novel_features.description: Distance-ranked nearby airports, flagging which have normal operations right now.
novel_features.rationale: Requires haversine math over the catalog's lat/lon joined to live status; the map renders but never ranks 'nearest healthy airport'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When your airport is melting down, 'where else can I fly from' is the immediate follow-up.

novel_features.name: Change diff since last sync
novel_features.description: What changed since the last sync: status transitions, new/cleared warnings, delay deltas.
novel_features.rationale: No upstream history exists (snapshot-only site); deltas exist only in the local SQLite snapshot history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Monitors and writers need 'what changed since this morning' — the numbers reset upstream, local history persists.

narrative.headline: Every Flighty Airports meltdown map feature, plus cross-airport intelligence no web page can answer.
narrative.value_prop: Live status, METAR weather, performance, and flight boards for 156 tracked airports — parsed straight from Flighty's SSR payload with no app install, no API key, and no login. Then it goes further than the site: network-wide rankings, airline footprints, route checks, healthy alternates, and change diffs, all from a local SQLite mirror that keeps working offline.

quickstart.comment: See which airports are melting down right now
Full status, weather (raw METAR), and today's performance for one airport
Rank the network — the web map never ranks
Find one flight across arrivals and departures boards
Mirror the catalog locally for offline search and cross-airport commands

troubleshoots.symptom: airports show says airport not found
troubleshoots.fix: Use the IATA code (den) or exact slug (denver-intl-den); run flighty-pp-cli airports list to see tracked airports

troubleshoots.symptom: Cross-airport commands (worst, nearby, airline, diff) return empty
troubleshoots.fix: Run flighty-pp-cli sync --resources airports --full first — those commands read the local mirror
Re-sync or use --data-source live on commands that support it; Flighty updates the site continuously

narrative.when_to_use: When you or an agent need live airport disruption status, METAR weather, flight boards, or cross-airport disruption intelligence from the terminal. Ideal for pre-flight checks, travel-agent sweeps, meltdown-day writeups, and automation that needs JSON airport data without a private API.
anti_triggers: Tracking a specific flight's live position — use Flighty's app or a flight-tracking API like AeroAPI; this CLI covers airport-level status only
Flight booking or price search — use a booking API; Flighty Airports has no pricing data
Personal flight history — the community Flighty MCP servers read your app database; this CLI is public-airport-data only
Airports not on the meltdown map — the site tracks 156 airports; unlisted airports are unavailable
